facts.fact: The ministry reports that on 28 February 2024 the President commissioned in Pointe-Noire the ARPCE data centre (54 racks), connected to the WACS and 2Africa cables and able to host the data of public administration and of the private sector.
The ministry describes the ARPCE Pointe-Noire data centre, put into service 28 February 2024, as Tier 3+ (operator/ministry statement, no Uptime or TIA-942 certification cited).
